The `/v3/search` endpoint is the right tool. Let me pull its full spec.

Here's how to query ISC audit/activity events using the **Search API**.

## Endpoint

```
POST https://{tenant}.api.identitynow.com/v3/search
Authorization: Bearer <token>
Content-Type: application/json
```

**Required scope:** `sp:search:read`

---

## Request body

The Search API uses Elasticsearch-style DSL. Set `indices` to `["events"]` — that's the audit log index. Use a `bool` query to combine an event-type filter with a 24-hour date range.

```json
{
  "indices": ["events"],
  "queryType": "SAILPOINT",
  "query": {
    "query": "type:USER_AUTHENTICATION_STEP"
  },
  "filters": {
    "created": {
      "type": "RANGE",
      "range": {
        "lower": {
          "value": "now-24h",
          "inclusive": true
        },
        "upper": {
          "value": "now",
          "inclusive": true
        }
      }
    }
  },
  "sort": ["-created"],
  "includeNested": true
}
```

Add `?limit=250&count=true` to the URL to control page size and get the total count back in `X-Total-Count`.

---

## Common `type` values for the `events` index

| Type string | What it covers |
|---|---|
| `USER_AUTHENTICATION_STEP` | Login / MFA events |
| `PROVISIONING_ACTION` | Provisioning create/modify/delete |
| `ACCESS_REQUEST_SUBMITTED` | Access request opened |
| `ACCESS_REQUEST_APPROVED` | Access request approved |
| `SOURCE_ACCOUNT_AGGREGATION` | Aggregation runs |
| `CERTIFICATION_SIGNED_OFF` | Review sign-offs |

To query **all** event types in the window, just drop the `query` field (or set `"query": "*"`).

---

## Pagination past 10,000 records

For large result sets use `searchAfter` (keyset pagination) instead of `offset`:

```json
{
  "indices": ["events"],
  "query": { "query": "type:PROVISIONING_ACTION" },
  "filters": { "created": { "type": "RANGE", "range": { "lower": { "value": "now-24h", "inclusive": true }, "upper": { "value": "now", "inclusive": true } } } },
  "sort": ["-created", "id"],
  "searchAfter": ["2026-07-22T15:30:00.000Z", "abc123-last-id-from-prior-page"]
}
```

Pass the last record's sort values as `searchAfter` in the next request. Repeat until you get fewer results than your `limit`.

---

## Quick curl example

```bash
TOKEN=$(curl -s -X POST "https://{tenant}.api.identitynow.com/oauth/token" \
  -d "grant_type=client_credentials&client_id=$CLIENT_ID&client_secret=$CLIENT_SECRET" \
  | jq -r .access_token)

curl -s -X POST "https://{tenant}.api.identitynow.com/v3/search?limit=250&count=true" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "indices": ["events"],
    "queryType": "SAILPOINT",
    "query": { "query": "type:USER_AUTHENTICATION_STEP" },
    "filters": {
      "created": {
        "type": "RANGE",
        "range": {
          "lower": { "value": "now-24h", "inclusive": true },
          "upper": { "value": "now",    "inclusive": true }
        }
      }
    },
    "sort": ["-created"]
  }'
```

---

```answer-summary
  - method: POST
    path: /v3/search
    api_version: v3
auth_flow: OAuth2 bearer token
required_scopes: [sp:search:read]
key_parameters: [indices, query, filters, sort, searchAfter, limit, count]
```
